import fluentqt
from PySide6.QtGui import QStandardItem, QStandardItemModel
from PySide6.QtCore import QItemSelectionModel
from PySide6.QtWidgets import QAbstractItemView
python.setup:
control = fluentqt.Timeline(%PARENT%)
control.setHeaderText("Release milestones")
model = QStandardItemModel(control)
for label in ["Spec signed off", "API frozen", "Beta release"]:
    model.appendRow(QStandardItem(label))
control.setModel(model)
control.setAnimationEnabled(False)
model.setData(model.index(0, 0), "09:00", fluentqt.Timeline.DataRole.TimestampRole)
model.setData(model.index(0, 0), "Requirements reviewed", fluentqt.Timeline.DataRole.DescriptionRole)
model.setData(model.index(0, 0), fluentqt.Timeline.Status.Success, fluentqt.Timeline.DataRole.StatusRole)
model.setData(model.index(1, 0), "11:30", fluentqt.Timeline.DataRole.TimestampRole)
model.setData(model.index(1, 0), "Public API stable", fluentqt.Timeline.DataRole.DescriptionRole)
model.setData(model.index(1, 0), fluentqt.Timeline.Status.Active, fluentqt.Timeline.DataRole.StatusRole)
model.setData(model.index(2, 0), "15:00", fluentqt.Timeline.DataRole.TimestampRole)
model.setData(model.index(2, 0), "Ready for feedback", fluentqt.Timeline.DataRole.DescriptionRole)
model.setData(model.index(2, 0), fluentqt.Timeline.Status.Neutral, fluentqt.Timeline.DataRole.StatusRole)
